name: dsh-quote-archive
description: Archive, search, and recall group-chat quotes locally, with an agent-callable quote tool and a full AstrBot-style management page (library, statistics, insights, trash, people, collections, and collaboration). Needs Node.js 22.13+; QQ capture and reposting are optional and require a running SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP gateway, whose address and access token the plugin finds automatically in local SnowLuma and qq-bridge config files.

scripts.test: node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/apply.mjs && node tests/onebot.test.mjs && node tests/collect.test.mjs && node tests/webapi.test.mjs && node tests/manage.test.mjs && node tests/discovery.test.mjs
